provenance: City of Berkeley 'Potential Bond Measure Projects' list (36 items, pp.61-63 of the council packet; totals: Parks/Rec/Waterfront $90,697,000 + Public Works $75,135,000 + Fire $106,668,000 = $272,500,000 project costs; $300M bond + $13M interest earnings = $313M program incl. $40.5M staffing/implementation). Costs and descriptions are the CITY'S; the category sort (A=durable long-life low-carry, B=catch-up renewal of existing assets, C=new/expanded capacity with permanent new O&M), design-life classes, and recurs-before-2067 flags are the WORKING GROUP'S v0 professional judgment, pending the City's own engineering figures. Design-life ranges follow standard facility/asset planning practice.

projects.name: Frances Albrier Community Center replacement
projects.notes: Replacement of undersized facility with larger one — permanent O&M grows with the footprint; seismic; all-electric applies.

projects.notes: Aquatic facilities carry among the highest O&M per sq ft of any city asset class; pool MEP systems recur within ~20-25 yr.
